description: This file defines a helper class 'SecurityTestHelper' used for testing PDF security and encryption options in the PdfSharp library. It includes enumerations for different encryption configurations, methods to apply security settings to PDF documents, and utilities for managing test file naming and retrieval based on security options.

classes.name: SecurityTestHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing constants, enums, and methods for testing PDF security configurations in the PdfSharp library.

nested_classes.name: TestData
nested_classes.description: Contains nested classes implementing various test encryption configurations for parameterized tests.

nested_classes.name: TestOptions
nested_classes.description: Represents configuration options for encrypting PDF documents during tests, including encryption type and passwords.

nested_classes.name: TestDataBase
nested_classes.description: Abstract base class for enumerating test encryption configurations, supporting conditions and skipping logic.

methods.name: SecureDocument
methods.description: Applies security settings to a PdfDocument based on specified TestOptions, configuring passwords and encryption type.

methods.name: AddPrefixToFilename
methods.description: Creates a filename prefix indicating encryption and metadata status for test files.

methods.name: AddSuffixToFilename
methods.description: Creates a filename suffix indicating encryption and metadata status for test files.

methods.name: GetFilenamePrefix
methods.description: Helper method to generate filename prefix based on encryption options.

methods.name: GetAssetsTestFile
methods.description: Retrieves the path to a test asset file for a given security configuration, handling caching and versioning.
